digest.component_or_area: config ownership gate / RP-04 ambient-read cutover
propositions: Over 110 direct ambient config/credential reads via os.getenv, os.environ, load_config, and backend property reloads currently exist below approved composition seams across multiple subsystems and must be eliminated or registered.

Every below-seam ambient read must either be routed through the central approved seam (operation snapshot, startup binding, or provider boundary) or registered as a test-only/protocol-constant exception with exact path, symbol, and rationale.
The legacy-exception set (slice C1) must reach EMPTY with no path-glob exceptions and no legacy facades or per-job ambient reloads remaining after their focused behavioral suites pass.

All S1-S6 behavioral suites must remain green after each subsystem cutover and after legacy-facade removal, with redacted operation snapshot fingerprints and provider-neutral outcomes unchanged except for explicitly recorded approved deltas.

Legacy facades, migration switches, and per-job ambient reloads are removed only after their focused suites and bounded paths pass; rollback before removal selects the facade and retains the S1 snapshot-envelope compatibility floor.
